newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania has gained encouragements through the first reactions to President Ion Iliescu's messages delievered to the leaders of all 16 NATO member-countries, presidency spokesman Traian Chebeleu told a news conference.

The message pledging for the Balkan country's admission in a first wave of alliance expansion enjoyed a particularly positive reaction with France which said it cannot conceive this first wave without Romania, Chebeleu said.
* Daniel Tarschys, Secretary General of the Council of Europe, is expected to meet Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu in Bucharest in the afternoon.
* United Nations Development Programme organised action to help cleaning Bucharest in the Pieptanari district on Thursday.

* English-language courses have been one of the most important activities hosted by the British Council in Bucharest, its president Sir Martin Jacomb said during his visit to Romania. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
